caption: The drawing features a small wooden sewing stand that is colored in shades of reddish-brown, giving it the appearance of polished wood. The stand has four turned, cylindrical legs connected by stretchers, and a rectangular tabletop surface. On top of the surface is a shallow backboard with two sides and a small horizontal shelf, which also has a small round knob or pull in the center. Directly beneath the tabletop is a single drawer with a similar round knob or pull for opening. The background is plain and off-white, and centered below the sewing stand is text in a neat handwriting style that reads "Small Red Sewing Stand." There are no other objects included in the drawing.
title: Shaker Sewing Table
